content:
maria: Quick scrub — reservation gap found for eu-west-1 slice-B. Procurement ETA slipped a day. Current milestones I have: procurement arrival 2024-03-19, rack cabling 2024-03-20, partial power 2024-03-20 evening, full power 2024-03-21, burn-in 2024-03-22, canary 2024-03-24. Need owners for: fallback routing, canary capacity target, and who runs the first smoke. Who can own?

tony: I can own fallback routing + canary traffic plan. Propose we start canary with 8 nodes (64 H100 GPUs) and keep 1 node spare for warm standby -> ~56 usable gpus available. That keeps latency SLO headroom. Thoughts?

kevin: procurement update: vendor confirmed earliest vessel arrival 3/19 but customs hold could add 24-48h. I'm pushing manifest now. Will update if ETA moves.

andrew: data center update — power scheduling: we have partial PDUs available 3/20 morning (2 racks), full rack power confirmed for 3/21 03:00 UTC. If we want earlier canary we can do split canary on 2 racks on 3/20 but it's limited to ~40 GPUs.

sarah: runtime note: before canary we need KV cache priming and updated batching config. I opened PR #4023 with the batching thresholds and cache priming hook. Need review from eng-runtime and platform. If we only have 40 GPUs for initial canary, set batching max_tokens lower so we don't hit tail latency.

julia: I'll own the canary runbook (playbook + rollback steps). I'll create a doc and post link. Preliminary rollback trigger: p95 generation latency >250ms for 3m OR error rate >1% over 5m. Fallback action: shift traffic to hosted pool and pull nodes out of rotation.

maria: @tony @sarah @julia thanks. @kevin can you confirm manifest by EOD PST? If customs delays push arrival to 3/20 we should pre-approve split-canary on 3/20 and full on 3/24.

kevin: will confirm by EOD PST. If manifests look clean I can also request expedited customs broker.

tony: routing details — I'll create a small routing policy: priority list = [dedicated-canary, dedicated-spare, hosted-fallback]. TTL for shift = 30s, gradual v2->v1 rollback over 10m to avoid thundering. I'll post the routing config snippet here once I wire up the canary alias.

ops-bot: reservation-service: created reservation res-azi-eu-20240319 slice-B count=8 nodes (64 GPUs) owner=kevin, reservation_ts=3040001125

andrew: ops note: please add a preflight checklist item to confirm PDUs and BMC access before power-on. Last time a missing switch credential delayed burn-in 6h.

sarah: tagging eng-runtime reviewers @matt @olivia — please skim PR #4023 today. I also added a small stress test: `./stress --len=1024 --qps=200` that we should run during burn-in.

julia: created runbook draft -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-dedicated-sliceB (internal link). Included rollback steps, monitoring queries, and postmortem checklist. Will add traffic shift playbook after @tony posts routing policy.

maria: OK. Owners recap: procurement = @kevin, routing/canary policy = @tony, runtime changes/reviews = @sarah, runbook/ops = @julia, datacenter power = @andrew. Action items: 1) kevin confirm manifest by EOD PST; 2) tony post routing config; 3) sarah get reviews merged; 4) julia finalize runbook and schedule canary window. Ping back here when each done.

tony: sgtm, will post routing snippet in ~1h. :thumbsup:

kevin: ack, pushing manifest now.

sarah: will ping reviewers and aim to merge before 3/21.

julia: will finalize runbook and set the canary calendar invite for 3/20 18:00 UTC (split canary) and 3/24 06:00 UTC (full canary).

maria: thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the canonical async tracker. If anything shifts, please drop a one-line update here so we can keep the timeline accurate.

tony: routing snippet (draft):
```
route {
  alias: "sliceB-canary"
  priority: ["dedicated-canary", "dedicated-spare", "hosted-fallback"]
  shift_policy: {
    step: 10%,
    step_interval: 60s,
    rollback_on: "p95>250ms for 180s or err_rate>1%"
  }
}
```

maria: looks good, @tony. Please add sensible guardrails for token amplification workloads.

andrew: added checklist item: verify PDU firmware and BMC creds. Will post verification note when done.

ops-bot: reminder: capacity-reserve window closes in 48h. Please confirm reservations or they may be released.

maria: noted. kevin, if customs looks risky can you request expedited broker now so we don't lose the reservation?

kevin: requested broker escalate. I'll follow up in this thread with manifest ID and tracking number.

julia: prepping post-canary validation queries (latency, cost per token, generation quality quick sample). Will add to runbook and link to the eval harness.

maria: great. Looping in @product if any customer-facing canary needs to be communicated. End of async update.
